name: Bootstrap: toolchain, workspace, Accelerate ABI
note: Verified by Claude. Backend decided in ADR 0004 (faer, ndrustfft) after spike P0C; the hand-written FFI was removed in P1A

name: Units, lattice, G-vectors, FFT
note: Verified by Claude. Si fcc 30 Ry: 749 plane waves, 5985 density G, FFT 25x25x25. FFT grid choice vs QE is compared in P6

name: UPF parser, local and KB nonlocal terms
note: Parser, radial transforms, KB assembly verified on synthetic fixtures; the real Si file parses (three real-world deviations fixed in P2C and P5C) and its header matches dft5090's report

name: Hamiltonian, Hartree, LDA XC
note: Hamiltonian, Hartree, XC, kinetic, Ewald, local convolution vs explicit matrix verified on synthetic pseudopotentials. Real-Si validation comes with P5/P6

name: Eigensolver (dense baseline, then Davidson/LOBPCG)
note: Dense (faer) and block Davidson verified. LOBPCG not needed for MVP

name: SCF loop and total energy
note: Si Gamma-only LDA SCF converges (11 iterations, 1.2 s): -7.295530468210927 Ha; compared with QE 7.6 in P6 (docs/validation.md R3 to R5)

name: QE reference comparison and MVP approval
note: All six comparison gates met against QE 7.6 on Si (energy, eigenvalues, electrons, iterations, cutoff scan, density in Fourier space). Left: final review and the user's approval. Pseudopotential provenance unverified; one cell, Gamma only; density checked on 12 sampled coefficients

name: k점, 단위, 수식 입력, PBE, 성능 개선(5~9배), 병렬화
note: 완료: k점(QE 3개 격자 일치), 단위(uom), 수식 입력, PBE(QE와 일치), 성능 개선(FFT, Davidson, SCF 스케줄, k점/밴드 병렬화; dev08 32개 k점 98.98 s -> 1.23 s, QE 같은 코어 수 대비 1.8배 느림). 진행: 8원자 셀 미수렴 수정(P7PC), MKL 선택 백엔드 설계(ADR 0019). 남음: GPU 설계 노트

name: 기능 확장 기획과 출력(밴드/DOS, 체적), 마스터 계획
note: 밴드/DOS 출력(P8A), 체적 데이터 출력(P8B), XC·다체물리 로드맵(P8D), 기능 격차 조사(P8E), VASP/QE 전체 기능 행렬과 마스터 계획(P8F)을 병렬 진행 중. 결과는 마스터 로드맵으로 통합 예정
